title: Sight Glass

introduction.definition: A sight glass is a window built into piping or vessels so that operators can see the process fluid — whether it is flowing, its colour and clarity, bubbles, foam or level. The flow-through, double-window type allows light to shine through from the opposite side.
applications: Visual check of flow and liquid quality
key_points: Glass is the weak point — rating and thermal shock limits

introduction.summary: A sight glass lets operators see the liquid inside a pipe: its colour, clarity, flow, bubbles or the presence of liquid at all. The double-window, flow-through type is lit from one side and viewed from the other.

foundation: Support the valve and adjoining pipe so the body does not carry pipe weight or thermal loads; heavy valves need their own supports.
alignment: Align flanges face-to-face and bore-to-bore before bolting; never pull pipes into place with the bolts.
Respect the flow-direction arrow on the body.
piping: Flush the line before installing the valve so welding debris cannot damage seats.
Provide isolation and drain/vent points for maintenance.
Allow access for the handwheel/actuator and for removal of internals.
commissioning: Check the valve strokes fully and smoothly.
Pressure-test the line (shell test) with the valve partly open; do not use the valve to blind a test above its seat rating.
Record the as-installed position and set points.

routine.task: Check glass for cracks, chips and etching.

overhaul.task: Replace glass and gaskets; re-torque evenly.

video_tutorials.title: Sight Glass — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Sight Glass.
A sight glass is a window built into piping or vessels so that operators can see the process fluid — whether it is flowing, its colour and clarity, bubbles, foam or level.
The flow-through, double-window type allows light to shine through from the opposite side.
Typical applications include visual check of flow and liquid quality; condensate and steam lines; chemical and pharmaceutical batch processes; filling and transfer lines.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Body (flow-through chamber).
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

script.narration: How the Sight Glass works.
Fluid flows through the chamber.
Toughened glass windows let the operator see inside.
Bubbles and colour indicate gas entrainment or contamination.
Cover rings clamp the glass on gaskets.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.

video_tutorials.title: Sight Glass — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Sight Glass.
Check glass for cracks, chips and etching.
Clean glass.
Replace glass and gaskets; re-torque evenly.
Watch for glass breakage: leak, broken window. Common cause: thermal shock, uneven bolting, impact.
Watch for etched/fogged glass: cannot see. Common cause: Caustic/HF attack.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
